name_en: Amimeshi — tsukudani-style dried krill folded into steamed rice
summary_ja: みりんや醤油、しょうがで甘辛く煮付けたアミの佃煮を、炊きたてのごはんに混ぜ込む宇佐市・中津市・豊後高田市域の料理。豊前海の干潟で秋から冬に水揚げされるアミを活かす、県北地域の人気料理の一つ。
summary_en: Krill simmered sweet-savory in mirin, soy sauce, and ginger is folded into freshly steamed rice — a dish from the Usa, Nakatsu, and Bungotakada coast, where krill are hauled from the Buzen Sea tideflats each autumn and winter; a favorite of the northern Oita coast.
source_title: あみめし 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ohan — rice steamed golden with gardenia fruit, served with a savory vegetable topping
summary_ja: くちなしの実で染めた水で米を炊き、白身魚や豆腐、大根を煮た「かやく」を添える臼杵市の郷土料理。倹約令の続いた旧臼杵藩で贅沢な赤飯の代わりに考案されたと伝わり、大晦日に仕込んだかやくを三が日温め直して食べる。
summary_en: Rice is steamed in water tinted golden with gardenia fruit and topped with kayaku, a simmer of white fish, tofu, and daikon — a dish from Usuki said to have been devised as a stand-in for extravagant red rice under the domain's austerity edicts, the kayaku made in bulk on New Year's Eve and reheated through the first days of the year.
source_title: 黄飯と黄飯かやく 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Oita torimeshi — rice cooked or mixed with simmered chicken, burdock, and carrot
summary_ja: 鶏肉とごぼう、人参などを炊き込む、または煮込んで炊きたてのごはんに混ぜる大分の飯料理。卵を産まなくなった親鶏を使うのが本来の姿とされ、猟師が客をもてなすために野鳥でつくったのが起源との説も伝わる。
summary_en: Chicken, burdock, and carrot are either cooked into the rice or simmered separately and folded through it once steamed — an Oita rice dish traditionally made from a hen past laying, with one account tracing its roots to a hunter's dish of wild fowl served to guests.
source_title: 鶏めし 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
